problems.title: Price War
problems.situation: Your biggest competitor has reduced prices by 30%, and your sales have started declining. Matching their prices would protect market share but could make several of your products unprofitable.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you defend market share without destroying your margins?

problems.title: Customer Retention Crisis
problems.situation: Your customer retention has fallen by 25% in three months, while customer acquisition costs have increased significantly.
problems.ceo_challenge: Will you focus resources on winning new customers or retaining existing ones—and what specific changes will you make?

problems.title: Inventory Trap
problems.situation: You have ₹2 crore worth of unsold seasonal inventory, and its market value is falling rapidly.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you convert the inventory into cash without heavily damaging your brand, pricing, or future sales?

problems.title: Supplier Shock
problems.situation: Your primary supplier has increased prices by 35%, directly affecting your margins.
problems.constraint: Switching suppliers could take three months and may temporarily reduce product quality.
problems.ceo_challenge: Will you renegotiate, switch suppliers, absorb the cost, increase prices, or redesign your supply chain?

problems.title: Expansion vs Defence
problems.situation: Your company is growing rapidly in its current market, but a strong competitor has entered the new market you planned to expand into.
problems.constraint: You do not have enough resources to aggressively defend the existing market and aggressively enter the new one simultaneously.
problems.ceo_challenge: Where will you place your next major investment?

problems.title: Reputation Crisis
problems.situation: A viral social-media complaint claims your company delivered a poor-quality product. Customer trust and new orders have started falling.
problems.constraint: The complaint is spreading faster than your investigation can determine whether the customer's claim is completely accurate.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you respond publicly while deciding what operational action to take?

problems.title: Rising Costs
problems.situation: Food and operating costs have increased by 25%, but a significant price increase could drive customers toward competitors.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you protect profitability without losing your customer base?

problems.title: Competitor Attack
problems.situation: A major food chain has opened multiple outlets near your highest-performing locations.
problems.constraint: The competitor has a significantly larger marketing budget and can afford aggressive introductory discounts.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you defend your locations without entering an unsustainable price war?

problems.title: Customer Decline
problems.situation: Monthly customers have fallen by 30%, even though your product quality and customer ratings remain relatively strong.
problems.ceo_challenge: What do you believe is the root problem, and where will you invest first to recover demand?

problems.title: Staff Crisis
problems.situation: Nearly 30% of your experienced employees have resigned within one month, putting pressure on service quality.
problems.constraint: Hiring replacements quickly may bring inexperienced employees who require training.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you maintain service quality while rebuilding the workforce?

problems.title: Failed Expansion
problems.situation: A newly opened outlet is consistently losing money and has achieved only 60% of its expected customer volume.
problems.constraint: Closing immediately would create a significant financial loss, but continuing unchanged will increase losses.
problems.ceo_challenge: Will you turn around, relocate, temporarily close, or permanently exit the outlet?

problems.title: Food Safety Reputation Crisis
problems.situation: A customer posts a viral video claiming your company served poor-quality food, causing widespread negative attention.
problems.constraint: An internal investigation has not yet confirmed whether the incident was isolated or part of a larger operational problem.
problems.ceo_challenge: What will you do in the first 48 hours?

problems.title: Free Competitor
problems.situation: A major competitor has started offering a similar learning platform completely free of charge.
problems.constraint: Your current cost structure does not allow you to offer the same service for free.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you compete without simply copying the competitor?

problems.title: Student Dropout
problems.situation: Student subscription cancellations have increased by 40% in the last quarter.
problems.constraint: New enrollments are still growing, meaning the company may be hiding the problem through aggressive acquisition.
problems.ceo_challenge: Will you prioritize acquisition or retention, and what will you change?

problems.title: Pricing Pressure
problems.situation: Students are demanding lower prices while instructor and platform costs continue to increase.
problems.constraint: A major price reduction would significantly reduce your ability to maintain course quality.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you redesign your pricing or business model?

problems.title: Faculty Crisis
problems.situation: Several of your highest-rated instructors have received offers from a competing platform and are preparing to leave.
problems.constraint: Matching every competitor offer would significantly increase your operating costs.
problems.ceo_challenge: Which talent do you retain, how do you retain them, and what happens to the remaining faculty?

problems.title: Engagement Failure
problems.situation: Your new learning platform received strong initial interest, but 70% of new users stop using it after the first month.
problems.constraint: Marketing has already generated strong awareness, so simply spending more on acquisition is unlikely to solve the core problem.
problems.ceo_challenge: What will you change in the product or learning experience?

problems.title: Career Outcome Crisis
problems.situation: A viral review claims your courses are not delivering the career outcomes promised to students.
problems.constraint: Some claims are exaggerated, but several genuine student complaints have also been identified.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you protect the brand while addressing the underlying problem?

problems.title: Subscriber Loss
problems.situation: Your subscription numbers have fallen by 30% after a competitor launched a significantly cheaper service.
problems.constraint: Matching the competitor's price would make your current subscription model difficult to sustain.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you reduce churn without simply starting a price war?

problems.title: Content Failure
problems.situation: You invested heavily in a new show/content series, but it has received extremely poor audience ratings.
problems.constraint: Significant production costs have already been spent, and additional episodes are contractually committed.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you continue, modify, cancel, or reposition the content?

problems.title: Creator Loss
problems.situation: Your most popular creator has received an exclusive offer from a competitor.
problems.constraint: The creator contributes a major share of your platform's engagement, but matching the competitor's offer would be financially difficult.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you retain the creator at a high cost or reduce your dependence on them?

problems.title: Advertising Decline
problems.situation: Advertising revenue has fallen by 35% as major advertisers move to competing platforms.
problems.constraint: Increasing ad volume could reduce user experience and accelerate audience decline.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you rebuild advertising revenue without damaging the audience?

problems.title: Platform Shift
problems.situation: Your audience is rapidly moving from your primary platform to a new social-media platform.
problems.constraint: You have limited resources to maintain your existing platform while building a presence on the new one.
problems.ceo_challenge: Where will you invest—and what will you deliberately stop doing?

problems.title: Reputation Crisis
problems.situation: A controversial piece of content published by your company triggers significant public backlash.
problems.constraint: Removing the content could satisfy critics but may anger another section of your audience and create questions about editorial independence.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you remove, modify, defend, or contextualize the content?

problems.title: Membership Decline
problems.situation: Gym membership has fallen by 30% after a low-cost fitness chain opened nearby.
problems.constraint: Matching the competitor's price would make your current gym model unprofitable.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you retain customers without entering a price war?

problems.title: Customer Retention
problems.situation: Nearly 35% of new members cancel within their first three months.
problems.constraint: Customer acquisition is still strong, so the company could continue growing despite poor retention—but at an increasingly high cost.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you fix the retention problem?

problems.title: Expansion Risk
problems.situation: You have the opportunity to open five new locations, but several existing locations are struggling to remain profitable.
problems.constraint: Expanding now could accelerate growth but would spread management and financial resources thinner.
problems.ceo_challenge: Expand, delay, or use a phased strategy?

problems.title: Trainer Loss
problems.situation: Several of your most popular trainers have joined a competing fitness company.
problems.constraint: These trainers have strong personal relationships with members, and some members are considering following them.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you protect membership and rebuild your trainer team?

problems.title: Changing Consumer Behaviour
problems.situation: Customers are increasingly choosing home workouts and fitness apps instead of physical gyms.
problems.constraint: Your existing gym network carries significant fixed costs and cannot simply be shut down.
problems.ceo_challenge: Will you defend the traditional gym model, build a digital offering, or combine both?

problems.title: Brand Crisis
problems.situation: A customer complaint about your services goes viral and begins damaging your brand.
problems.constraint: The complaint is receiving attention before your investigation is complete.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you respond publicly while determining whether the complaint reveals a wider operational issue?

problems.title: Fuel Cost Shock
problems.situation: Fuel and transportation costs have increased by 30%, significantly reducing your margins.
problems.constraint: Many of your largest contracts have fixed prices and cannot immediately be renegotiated.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you protect profitability without losing major customers?

problems.title: Delivery Failure
problems.situation: Your on-time delivery rate has fallen from 95% to 72% in three months.
problems.constraint: Increasing the delivery fleet immediately would be expensive, and the exact cause of the delays has not yet been fully identified.
problems.ceo_challenge: What will you fix first?

problems.title: Major Customer Loss
problems.situation: Your largest client, responsible for a significant share of revenue, announces that it is moving its logistics operations to a competitor.
problems.constraint: Winning the customer back may require lower pricing that could reduce already-thin margins.
problems.ceo_challenge: Fight to retain the customer or diversify away from the account?

problems.title: Workforce Crisis
problems.situation: Driver turnover has increased sharply, causing delivery delays across your network.
problems.constraint: Increasing driver salaries may improve retention but significantly increase operating costs.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you solve the workforce problem?

problems.title: Competitor Technology
problems.situation: A competitor introduces an AI-powered delivery system that is significantly faster and cheaper.
problems.constraint: Replacing your existing technology immediately would require major investment and operational disruption.
problems.ceo_challenge: Invest, partner, upgrade gradually, or change your business model?

problems.title: Expansion Problem
problems.situation: You have an opportunity to enter three new cities, but your current operations are already struggling to meet demand.
problems.constraint: Delaying expansion could allow competitors to establish themselves first.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you expand, stabilize first, or enter selectively?

problems.title: Competitor Pricing
problems.situation: A major competitor launches a similar product line at 40% lower prices.
problems.constraint: Matching their prices would severely damage your margins and premium positioning.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you defend your market position?

problems.title: Seasonal Inventory
problems.situation: 60% of your seasonal inventory remains unsold with the next season approaching.
problems.constraint: Heavy discounts could clear inventory quickly but may train customers to wait for sales and weaken your brand.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you clear the stock?

problems.title: Brand Relevance
problems.situation: Sales among younger customers have dropped significantly over the last year.
problems.constraint: Your existing customer base is older and highly profitable, so changing the brand too aggressively could alienate them.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you attract younger consumers without losing your existing customers?

problems.title: Supplier Crisis
problems.situation: Your primary manufacturing partner increases production costs by 30%.
problems.constraint: Switching suppliers could reduce quality and delay the next collection.
problems.ceo_challenge: Renegotiate, switch, absorb costs, increase prices, or redesign the collection?

problems.title: Celebrity Problem
problems.situation: Your biggest brand ambassador publicly ends their partnership with your company.
problems.constraint: Their exit has generated significant media attention and may influence customer perception.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you protect the brand and replace the ambassador's influence?

problems.title: Online vs Physical Expansion
problems.situation: Your online business is profitable, but opening physical stores requires a major investment with uncertain returns.
problems.constraint: Competitors are rapidly expanding into physical retail locations.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you invest in stores, remain digital-first, test smaller locations, or partner with existing retailers?

problems.title: Free Competitor
problems.situation: A competitor launches a free version of your core product with almost identical features.
problems.constraint: Your current business model depends heavily on paid subscriptions.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you lower prices, introduce a freemium model, differentiate the product, or change your revenue model?

problems.title: User Decline
problems.situation: Monthly active users have fallen by 35% over six months.
problems.constraint: Your marketing team wants to increase acquisition spending, but user feedback suggests existing customers may be leaving because of product issues.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you prioritize acquisition or fix retention first?

problems.title: Product Failure
problems.situation: Your latest product launch received strong initial downloads but extremely poor user retention.
problems.constraint: Marketing performance was successful, but the product itself appears unable to keep users engaged.
problems.ceo_challenge: Do you redesign the product, pause marketing, pivot, or continue investing?

problems.title: Talent Crisis
problems.situation: Your most experienced engineering team has received competing offers, and several members are preparing to leave.
problems.constraint: Matching every offer would significantly increase salary costs and create internal pay disparities.
problems.ceo_challenge: Who do you retain, how do you retain them, and how will you protect ongoing projects?

problems.title: Monetization Problem
problems.situation: Your product has millions of users but generates very little revenue.
problems.constraint: Aggressive advertising or paid features could increase revenue but may damage user experience and reduce engagement.
problems.ceo_challenge: How will you monetize the existing user base?

problems.title: Data & Trust Crisis
problems.situation: A security incident raises concerns among users about how your company handles personal data. Domain
problems.constraint: The investigation is still ongoing, and you do not yet know the full extent of the incident.
problems.ceo_challenge: What will you disclose, what will you fix first, and how will you protect user trust?
